item.title: Delhi high court cites national security, junks CIC order to IAF on PMs’ foreign trips
item.description: Allowing a petition by the Central Public Information Officer of Directorate of Personal Services, Air Headquarters, Justice Amit Mahajan held the IAF was justified in denying access to the records under section 8 of RTI that exempts disclosure of information that could jeopardise national security or pose a risk to a person’s life and physical safety.

item.title: India & United States to boost defence, energy ties, Marco Rubio says trade deal close
item.description: Rubio’s second visit to India comes against the backdrop of the US’s Sanctioning Russia and Iran Act, which is intended to penalise countries purchasing Russian oil, and Trump’s subsequent temporary suspension of related tariffs. India maintains that its oil procurement is essential not only for its own energy security but also for the stability of global markets. Rubio lauded the “substantial progress” made by India in diversifying its energy portfolio.
item.dc:creator: Sachin Parashar

item.title: Police lens on Lawrence Bishnoi’s aide Randeep Malik in Tiger Shroff shooting case
item.description: Anil Pandit Pandit and Shroff ’s shooter Rehan both reported to Malik and were considered “his men” till a few months ago, a source said. Rehan had been earlier tasked by Malik and Pandit with a shooting incident in Sonipat as well. “Rehan was shown the same ‘American dream’ that Malik had shown Pandit in the past,” a source said.
item.dc:creator: Raj Shekhar Jha

item.title: Allahabad HC cites long trial, lets off offenders, SC slams ‘misplaced sympathy’
item.description: A bench of Justices J B Pardiwala and K Vinod Chandran said it was a case of misplaced sympathy. The trial court had awarded fiveyear jail terms to the two, but the HC released them on probation. SC said the case was “doomed from its inception insofar as justice delivery to the victim is concerned”.
item.dc:creator: Amit Anand Choudhary

item.title: India, US ‘perfectly aligned’ on key issues: Marco Rubio; defends ties with Pakistan
item.description: Addressing a gathering of India Inc’s leading business figures, Rubio said the relationship between the two countries could help shape the future of the global economy, particularly as advances in artificial intelligence and quantum computing transform industries and societies. “I truly believe the relationship between US and India is defining, in many ways, in a positive way, what the 21st century can look like,” he said.

item.title: In talks with Reliance to refine more Venezuelan oil: US secretary of state Marco Rubio
item.description: US secretary of state Marco Rubio is visiting Jamnagar Wednesday to tour the Reliance refinery and, in a lastminute change of schedule, is likely to spend the night there. He was earlier scheduled to leave around 9pm and return to Mumbai. In Jamnagar, he will have dinner with Mukesh Ambani at the Vantara centre. Rubio’s visit to Jamnagar comes within weeks of a vicious attack on Ambani by Elon Musk.

item.title: AAIB chief gets a year's extension as many key probes, including AI 171, on
item.description: People in the know say while the aviation ministry “keeps the aircraft accident investigating agency at an arm’s length and does not interfere in its working in any way,” it is taking steps to strengthen the AAIB. The bureau's lab has been recently upgraded and it now has the capability to download cockpit voice recorder and digital flight data recorder (black box) to know the conversation in the flight deck and the flight parameters till before an event being investigated.
item.dc:creator: Saurabh Sinha

item.title: Two Andaman, one Chhattisgarh site added to Unesco World Heritage tentative list
item.description: India has added three sites to its tentative list for UNESCO World Heritage status, including the Karst-mud-volcano Complex. The sites are located in the Andaman and Nicobar Islands and Chhattisgarh, and the Archaeological Survey of India played a crucial role. Inclusion on this list is necessary for future nominations to the UNESCO World Heritage List. Currently, India possesses 45 UNESCO World Heritage Sites, ranking sixth in the world.
item.dc:creator: Pranjal Pandey

item.title: Delhi BJP leader burns giant cockroach effigy; CJP founder responds with SRK’s 'Swades' song
item.description: During Dussehra celebrations in Delhi, a 30-foot cockroach effigy was burned alongside traditional effigies of Ravan. Organizers stated that the effigy symbolized filth and promoted cleanliness in line with health awareness initiatives. Leaders of the Cockroach Janta Party reacted sharply, suggesting the move provided them with free publicity. Delhi minister Kapil Mishra remarked that cockroaches symbolize chaos and filth, reflecting public sentiment.
item.dc:creator: Vijaya Srivastava

item.title: 'Youth on streets are revolutionaries': Uddhav Thackeray calls for 'regime change'
item.description: During the vibrant Dussehra rally at Shivaji Park in Mumbai, Uddhav Thackeray rallied his supporters, highlighting the significance of youth activism in addressing the alleged electoral irregularities impacting the fresh electorate. He proclaimed that the saffron identity is a legacy of his party, urging a reformation in the political climate and the prominent display of the saffron flag, echoing the influence of Bal Thackeray in his passionate address.

item.title: PM Modi invokes 'Ram Rajya', warns against people hurting India's image - top quotes from Dussehra event
item.description: Prime Minister Narendra Modi addressed the Dussehra celebrations and highlighted the importance of public welfare. He emphasized the need for social justice and self-reliance as central to national development. Modi reminded attendees of the ideals of Lord Ram, focusing on justice and equal opportunities. He encouraged recognizing India's potential while serving the poor and marginalized. The Prime Minister referenced Vijayadashami as a celebration of the triumph of good over evil.

item.title: Air India Express flight suffers bird strike, lands safely in Bengaluru
item.description: An Air India Express flight en route from Bhogapuram to Bengaluru encountered a bird strike on Monday, yet all 148 passengers and crew emerged safely. Following the event, technical teams diligently inspected the aircraft, confirming it was in good condition for future flights. Notably, a comparable bird strike event affected an Emirates flight just days earlier on October 17.
item.dc:creator: Trisha Mahajan

item.title: Amit Shah meets families of anti-drug campaigners killed in Punjab; targets AAP on open drug trade
item.description: Amit Shah visited families of drug-related victims in Punjab, expressing condolences and discussing safety issues. He criticised the AAP government for its failure to tackle the drug menace effectively. Shah highlighted the dangers faced by those who oppose drug trafficking in the state. The recent murder of anti-drug activist Parvinder Singh Jhota escalated political tensions in Punjab.
item.dc:creator: Pranjal Pandey

item.title: ‘Felt very happy’: Annamalai welcomes Bhagwat's remarks on Muslims' place in India
item.description: K Annamalai lauded Mohan Bhagwat's recent statements on the significance of religious inclusivity in India. Speaking at a Faith Leaders Conference in New York, Bhagwat encouraged the embrace of diverse communities, including Muslims, reiterating the value of dignity for all. Annamalai pointed out the rising global fascination with Indian civilization, stressing the necessity for leaders and citizens to embody the nation's established ideals.
item.dc:creator: Aryan Singh
